title: Creamy Horchata Panna Cotta
description: A rich and creamy dessert infused with the sweet flavors of horchata, topped with a layer of caramelized sugar.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine heavy cream, horchata, and noble sugar.
Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract and a pinch of salt.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large baking dish.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, caramelize a layer of sugar on top by placing the dish under the broiler or using a kitchen torch.
